assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: ONE landscape 3:2 teaching scene sheet containing exactly FOUR equal 2x2 panels, with thin straight cream dividers at half width and half height. Reference image is ONLY a reference for the identity of the blue plush cat-like campus mascot (blue furry body, cream forehead stripe and muzzle). Do not copy the character sheet layout. Soft matte 3D plush campus illustration, ivory walls, pale sage, light wood, evenly lit. Each panel is one DIFFERENT lab environment with the blue mascot small, near the side, face fully visible. Neutral background scenarios, NOT instructions or answer diagrams. TOP LEFT: secured upright gas cylinder in a chain-secured cylinder stand, cap closed, a purpose-built cylinder trolley beside it, no connecting hoses, no leaking gas, no loose cylinders. TOP RIGHT: closed benchtop high-temperature furnace, a pair of crucible tongs resting unused on a nearby heatproof tray, small heat-resistant gloves stored beside the tray; nothing glowing, no flame and no handling hot objects. BOTTOM LEFT: a fully closed stopped benchtop laboratory centrifuge with an unused capped teaching-tube rack beside it; no exposed spinning rotor, no biological fluid. BOTTOM RIGHT: an enclosed switched-off optical laser teaching apparatus on an optical table with a beam enclosure and unmarked eye-protection case beside it; NO visible beam and no eye or hand in a beam path. Mascot wears clean lab coat and appropriate clear general eye protection, hands stay away from all controls; not conducting actual operations. No words, letters, digits, labels, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, tick/cross, colored correct/incorrect cues, smoke, spills, accidents or extra subpanels. Plenty of empty light wall above equipment; preserve a distinct equipment silhouette in every panel.

assets.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: single landscape 3:2 FOUR-OPTION visual comparison sheet for laboratory cylinder transport, exactly 4 equal panels 2x2, thin straight ivory dividers at exact halfway width/height. Reference ONLY for blue plush campus mascot identity, blue furry body, cream forehead stripe and muzzle. Soft matte 3D teaching illustration, cream and pale sage laboratory corridor, same camera and same medium-height neutral cylinder in all panels, full body and hands visible. Intentionally contrast one compliant action with three unsafe example actions; no injury, collision, fire, leaking gas or operational explanation. TOP LEFT: blue mascot moves the upright cylinder by gripping and lifting its top valve with a paw, cylinder base slightly above floor; no trolley, visibly gripping the valve rather than a handle. TOP RIGHT: blue mascot carries the cylinder horizontally across one shoulder using both paws, no trolley. BOTTOM LEFT: blue mascot pushes a purpose-built two-wheel gas-cylinder trolley by its rear handle; cylinder UPRIGHT and secured to trolley with TWO clearly visible straps or chains around its body, protective cap on, base rests on trolley footplate. BOTTOM RIGHT: blue mascot pushes a cylinder horizontally along the floor, cylinder body on the floor, no trolley. Mascot wears fitted sage workwear and closed shoes, no lab coat tails, no gloves. In all panels keep same size and setting, make physical differences unmistakable. Do not include any text, Chinese, numbers, letters, labels, symbols, speech bubbles, arrows, tick/cross, watermark, colored right/wrong borders or extra subpanels. No scary emotion or consequences; this is a classroom identification question.
